points: First time World Robotics Service Robots counts humanoids; only robots 1.4 m or taller included
The report tracks 1,001 companies worldwide offering service-robot solutions
Focus chapter: new robots for the workplace and construction sites
read: Fraunhofer IPA press release on World Robotics Service Robots 2026, 6 Oct 2026 (German)
take: The first official count of humanoid sales puts the hype in proportion: thousands, not millions. A baseline for judging vendor volume claims.
title: IFR and Fraunhofer IPA: almost 7,000 humanoids sold last year
